Online exam: daily challenge, 2027-01-06

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-01-06: Online exam. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

A national board runs a two-hour online exam for 200,000 students in three regions at the same time. Answers save automatically every half minute, a live heartbeat shows the student is still there, and proctoring marks suspicious events. Every saved answer matters. A minute of outage at the wrong time is a national story.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
